answer: Pick one task per epoch, have two unrelated peers re-run it from the submitted inputs, and hold payment in escrow until both results match. Example: a cleaning job that claims 4,000 rows processed is re-run in another region; one mismatch freezes the timber. Auditors rotate from a pool, so a forge of colluders has to guess who checks, and a cedar of fifty staged accounts still loses escrow on a single bad match.
